content.title: Relay Live Posting for GitHub
content.summary: Wire the relay skill's post-github adapter for live external posting via gh api, while keeping post-linear and post-slack as copy-only stubs. Add original comment context (author + body) to the HITL approval flow by embedding it at task creation time through the pr-revise harvest and to-tasks pipeline. Introduce a two-step approval gate (approve content, then confirm send) and per-task result summaries. Three new fields flow through the seed/task schemas: original_comment_body, original_comment_author, and thread_database_id.
decisions: GitHub adapter goes live first. Linear and Slack adapters remain copy-only stubs.
Use gh api (REST) for GitHub posting. Covers both flat PR comments and inline review thread replies via in_reply_to.
Embed original comment body at task creation time in pr-revise harvest, not fetched at relay time.
Display original comment above the draft reply in the HITL approval flow for reviewer context.
Posted comment contains draft text only. Original comment is shown only during HITL review, not repeated in the GitHub post.
Two new optional fields for original comment context on reply tasks: original_comment_body (string) and original_comment_author (string).
Two-step approval gate: approve content first, then confirm send with target URL displayed. Can be collapsed to single-step later once proven reliable.
On gh api failure: fail loud, ask user to retry, skip, or abort remaining tasks.
Remove never clauses and stub banner from post-github only. Egress-result schema already supports the posted status path with no changes needed.
Add thread_database_id field to carry REST numeric comment id alongside GraphQL node id. Flows pr-revise → seed provenance → to-tasks → relay → post-github.
Replace NO EXTERNAL CALLS MADE banner with per-task result summary table showing posted/skipped/failed/copy-only counts.
Two schemas updated: seed-schema.json (provenance item) and task-schema.json (reply task). All new fields are optional and additive.
Upstream touch points: pr-revise Step 3c (harvest original_comment_body, original_comment_author, thread_database_id into provenance) and to-tasks Step 3c (copy new fields to reply task).
Post-github agent tools: Bash + Read only. No additional MCP or write tools needed.
content.next_action: Generate implementation tasks via /to-tasks to produce the ordered work for wiring post-github live.
implementation_decisions: gh api uses the existing gh CLI auth (gho_**** token from keyring, scopes: gist, read:org, repo, workflow).
URL fragment parsing in post-github determines endpoint: #discussion_* → inline thread reply via in_reply_to, #r-comment-* → top-level PR comment via issues endpoint.
thread_id_type enum (graphql_node_id | database_id) already exists in seed schema. post-github uses thread_database_id for the in_reply_to parameter on inline threads.
For top-level PR comments (database_id type), use POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/comments.
For inline review thread replies (graphql_node_id type), use POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull}/comments with in_reply_to set to thread_database_id.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Original comment body may go stale if edited between pr-revise harvest and relay run. Accepted as minimal risk since relay typically runs same session.
Two-step approval adds friction. Accepted as safety measure for initial live posting rollout, can be collapsed later.
gh api failure modes include: network errors, expired auth, deleted PRs, permission issues. Handled via fail-loud-ask pattern.
further_notes: Linear and Slack adapters are explicitly deferred. Same pattern can be applied later: remove never clauses, add API/MCP calls, keep same egress-result contract.
HITL approval format: original comment by @author above, draft reply below, then approve/edit/skip, then confirm-send with target URL.

tasks.title: Wire post-github adapter for live posting via gh api
tasks.description: Replace the copy-only stub in post-github.md with live gh api posting. Remove the never clauses and NO EXTERNAL CALLS MADE banner. Implement two posting paths based on thread_id_type: for database_id (top-level PR comments), POST to /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/comments. For graphql_node_id (inline review threads), POST to /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull}/comments with in_reply_to set to thread_database_id. Parse owner, repo, and PR number from the reply_url. Return egress-result with status: posted, posted: true, and url set to the created comment URL from the gh api response. On failure, return status: failed with the error details.
acceptance_criteria: Never clauses and stub banner are removed from post-github.md
Top-level PR comments post via gh api to the issues comments endpoint
Inline review thread replies post via gh api with in_reply_to set to thread_database_id
Owner, repo, and PR number are parsed from the reply_url
Successful posts return egress-result with status: posted, posted: true, url: <created comment URL>
Failed posts return egress-result with status: failed, posted: false
A dry run against a test PR confirms the gh api call succeeds and returns the correct egress-result shape
tasks.summary: Replaced copy-only stub with live gh api posting. Two paths: issues endpoint for top-level comments, pulls/comments with in_reply_to for inline review threads. Returns egress-result with posted/failed status.

tasks.title: Update relay HITL approval flow with original comment, two-step gate, and result summary
tasks.description: Update relay SKILL.md to: (1) Display the original comment by @author above the draft reply in the HITL approval step, using original_comment_body and original_comment_author from the task. Gracefully skip when fields are absent. (2) Add a second confirmation step after content approval that shows the target URL and asks to confirm send before delegating to post-github. (3) Replace the NO EXTERNAL CALLS MADE invariant banner with a per-task result summary table showing posted/skipped/failed/copy-only counts. (4) On gh api failure from post-github, show the error and ask the user to retry, skip, or abort remaining tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Original comment displayed above draft when original_comment_body and original_comment_author are present
Approval flow gracefully skips original comment display when fields are absent
Second confirmation step shows target URL before delegating to adapter
Per-task result summary table replaces the old invariant banner
Summary shows counts for posted, skipped, failed, and copy-only statuses
On adapter failure, user is prompted to retry, skip, or abort
A dry run of relay with a task containing original comment fields shows the updated approval flow
tasks.summary: Updated relay SKILL.md: original comment display above draft, two-step approval with URL confirmation, retry/skip/abort on adapter failure, per-task result summary table replacing NO EXTERNAL CALLS banner.
